title: Mismapping of sequencing reads from polymorphic duplications generates spurious trans-eQTLs.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: paper_context.py: no PMCID, not open access in Europe PMC, no supplement, no accessions, no Zenodo/Dryad hits. The two NCBI-linked PMC records are unrelated (one is a Mol Biol Evol salivary-gene paper). One web search found only the related bioRxiv preprint (10.1101/2025.10.08.681258); no deposited table of flagged trans-eQTLs was found.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything else comes from the abstract: at least 15.4% (GTEx) and 6.1% (MAGE) of trans-eQTLs are flagged as spurious; GTEx has 838 people and MAGE 731.

a1_downloadable.note: No open full text or supplement. Recomputing the flag needs individual-level GTEx (Genotype-Tissue Expression) genotypes, which are controlled access through dbGaP (an NIH access-application database). Checked by the context script; paper text not read.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: The 'spurious' label would be the authors' own heuristic call. It is not a measured column and would have to be rebuilt from long-range linkage disequilibrium (LD, the non-random co-inheritance of variants) in genotype data.

a3_inputs_present.note: No feature table found; inputs would be genotypes and RNA-seq (RNA sequencing) alignments.

a5_enough_rows.note: Row count unknown. Published GTEx trans-eQTL lists are in the hundreds, so likely below 400 labelled positives (estimate, not verified).

a6_fits_laptop.note: Recomputing the flag needs whole-genome genotypes plus read realignment.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No files to compare against the paper.

a8_label_provenance.note: The label comes from the authors' LD-footprint rule, which is computed from genotype data that would also be features. A model would just relearn the rule (circular).

honest_claim_h3: A model could only reproduce the authors' rule for flagging spurious trans-eQTLs among the few hundred GTEx/MAGE trans-eQTLs; it would learn no independent biology.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use features of a genetic association between a variant and a distant gene to predict whether it is a read-mapping artifact.
plain_idea.train_on: Published trans-eQTLs (associations between a DNA variant and a gene's activity on a different chromosome) from GTEx and MAGE, with features such as effect size and distance; count unknown.
plain_idea.predict: Whether each association is spurious. The true answer is the authors' long-range linkage disequilibrium flag, a computed rule rather than a measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: People who map trans-eQTLs could filter out false positives. But the paper already gives a direct metric, so a model adds little.

ml_idea: Classify trans-eQTLs as spurious or real. Rejected: the label is a heuristic computed from genotypes, and those genotypes are controlled access.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; failed Part A before any data was found.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Check whether a supplementary table of flagged trans-eQTLs exists, and count its rows.

verdict_reason: No open data. The 'spurious' label is the authors' LD heuristic, computed from controlled-access GTEx genotypes (dbGaP). So it fails A1, A2 and A8, with too few rows.
